entities.summary: Annabelle Janet Ewing is a Scottish politician and lawyer who has served as a Deputy Presiding Officer of the Scottish Parliament since May 2021. A member of the Scottish National Party (SNP), she has been the Member of the Scottish Parliament (MSP) for the Cowdenbeath constituency since 2016, having previously been an MSP for the Mid Scotland and Fife region from 2011 to 2016. Ewing also served in the UK House of Commons as the Member of Parliament for Perth, from 2001 to 2005.
